a.name: Pop-up Atlas traveller
a.previewText: Hup! Ooh, look at that one pop up! Hee-hee! Wheee! Hmph. Eep! Ta-da! Mmm-hmm, this little paper meadow is my favourite place to wander.
briefs: Original voice for a thumb-sized, round, fluffy felt creature with a big head and tall cloud of hair: adorable, sunny and bubbly. Gender-neutral, young-sounding but not a baby. High and bright with soft fuzzy edges, like a warm adult voice raised six to eight semitones with small-creature formants. Bouncy sing-song delivery, delighted little gasps, giggles easily. No accent, no resemblance to any actor or existing character. Dry studio recording, no reverb.

b.name: Pop-up Atlas companion
b.previewText: Okay. Fine. Hm. Huh, nice. Hmph. Whoa! My turn. Heh. Mmm, careful on the bridge, it wobbles.
briefs: Original voice for a small, round, sleepy-eyed felt creature that carries a tiny umbrella: cute but wary, dry and a little grumpy, warm underneath. Gender-neutral adult performer using a soft, slightly raised cartoon-creature register, like a warm adult voice raised two to four semitones, soft slightly gravelly edges. Short mumbled delivery, small sighs, startled squeaks when surprised, reluctant chuckles. No accent, no resemblance to any actor or existing character. Dry studio recording, no reverb.

Original voice for a careful plush craft-felt creature. Gender-neutral adult performer, calm and a bit grumpy but kind. Mid-low register for a cartoon creature, soft and dry, unhurried mutters, understated reactions that crack into a small startled yelp. No accent, no resemblance to any actor or existing character. Close, dry studio recording, no reverb.
